description: Single source of truth for vendored libraries (specification section 4.4.3). Edit with deps/update_deps.py.

dependencies.name: sqlite
dependencies.purpose: Database engine for native documents, catalog and recovery (FTS5, STRICT)

dependencies.name: sqlitecpp
dependencies.purpose: RAII C++ access to SQLite: prepared statements and transactions

dependencies.name: libremidi
dependencies.purpose: Standard MIDI File reader/writer and MIDI device I/O (WinMM)

dependencies.name: miniaudio
dependencies.purpose: Audio output (WASAPI, null backend), resampling and WAV/RF64 encoding

dependencies.name: picosha2
dependencies.purpose: SHA-256 for object identities, manifests and fingerprints

dependencies.name: xxhash
dependencies.purpose: XXH3-64 for motif n-gram keys, IPC frame checksums and cache keys

dependencies.name: stduuid
dependencies.purpose: UUID values for library, asset and document identities

dependencies.name: nlohmann_json
dependencies.purpose: JSON, MessagePack and CBOR for CLI output, recipes, preferences and IPC

dependencies.name: cli11
dependencies.purpose: Command-line parsing for mwb-cli and every executable

dependencies.name: utf8proc
dependencies.purpose: NFKC case folding for search keys, tags and sort keys

dependencies.name: pegtl
dependencies.purpose: Search query grammar to typed AST

dependencies.name: rapidfuzz
dependencies.purpose: Fuzzy matching for the command palette and tag suggestions

dependencies.name: pcg
dependencies.purpose: PCG32 deterministic PRNG for seeded transformations and dither

dependencies.name: efsw
dependencies.purpose: Directory change notification behind the watcher adapter

dependencies.name: readerwriterqueue
dependencies.purpose: Lock-free SPSC queues for real-time paths

dependencies.name: concurrentqueue
dependencies.purpose: Lock-free MPSC control queues outside the audio path

dependencies.name: thread_pool
dependencies.purpose: Bounded job pool (BS::thread_pool)

dependencies.name: spdlog
dependencies.purpose: Rotating structured local logs

dependencies.name: miniz
dependencies.purpose: ZIP packaging of backups

dependencies.name: doctest
dependencies.purpose: Unit test framework (development only)

dependencies.name: nanobench
dependencies.purpose: Micro benchmarks (development only)

dependencies.name: tinysoundfont
dependencies.purpose: SoundFont 2 playback behind ISynth

dependencies.name: signalsmith_dsp
dependencies.purpose: Filters and envelopes for the built-in audition synth

dependencies.name: midifile
dependencies.purpose: craigsapp/midifile: independent SMF reader used as a test oracle (development only)
